features.text: HINGED STABILITY: Dual polycentric hinges provide adjustable flexion and extension control.
BREATHABLE NEOPRENE MATERIAL: Offers durable compression and lasting comfort.
LIGAMENT AND JOINT SUPPORT: Helps stabilize ACL, PCL, MCL, and LCL injuries as well as mild osteoarthritis.
SECURE PULL-ON DESIGN: Fits comfortably and stays in place during movement.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.

indications: ACL, PCL, MCL, and LCL injuries and instabilities
